questions.stem: A 65-year-old man was originally admitted 5 days ago for peritonitis due to a perforated peptic ulcer, for which he underwent surgical repair. A large-bore, right internal jugular venous catheter was placed during the operation. Minutes after catheter removal, the patient develops acute-onset shortness of breath and cough. On examination, he appears in respiratory distress. In addition to high-flow oxygen supplementation, the patient should be immediately placed in which of the following positions?
